name: Coroner Report
formDescription: Standard death investigation report for DMEC staff. Supports sections and icons.
template:
[divbox=transparent][center][img]https://i.ibb.co/0pgw9hHm/phmc.png[/img][/center][/divbox]

[divbox=transparent][br][/br][center]DEATH INVESTIGATION REPORT[/center]
[hr][/hr]

[center][bold]A.   WRITTEN REPORT[/bold][/center]

The County Coroner's Office has been called regarding the decease that occurred at the location of [bold]{{placeOfDeath}}[/bold]. Upon receiving the call from [bold]{{department}}[/bold], Coroner's Office dispatched a Staff Member to the crime scene to conduct an investigation on the [bold]{{dateTime}}[/bold].

[bold]{{coronerEmployee}}[/bold], Serial Number [bold]{{coronerBadge}}[/bold], arrived at the scene and identified the individual as [bold]{{decedentName}}[/bold], who is estimated to have died at [bold]{{pronouncedTimeOfDeath}}[/bold]. Following an initial investigation, the following [bold]synopsis[/bold] was recorded: {{synopsis}}

[conditional field="ReportRequested" value="true"]
A Coroner's Report was requested by the {{department}}, {{requestingOfficer}}.
[/conditional]

Based on the information gathered from the scene investigation and the decedent's medical history (if available), the probable cause of death was determined to be [bold]{{probableCauseOfDeath}}[/bold]. The manner of death was classified as [bold]{{mannerOfDeath}}[/bold].

[conditional field="evidenceLocker" value="true"]
Staff has placed {{evidenceLockerItems}} in the Evidence Locker.
[/conditional]
[/divbox]
[divbox=transparent][center][bold]B. PHOTOGRAPHIC DOCUMENTARY RECORD[/center]
[hr][/hr]
[center][size=85][bold][u]SCENE PHOTOGRAPHY[/u][/bold][/size][/center]
{{scenePhotosBBCode}}
[/divbox]

[divbox=transparent]
[center][bold]C. STATEMENT[/bold][/center]
[hr][/hr]
[size=85]I have made detailed notes of my findings and conclusions, and these notes are available for review if necessary. I certify that the information contained in this report is true and accurate to the best of my knowledge and belief.[/size]
[/divbox]
